title: A Generic Five-Beat Script
description: Deliberately niche-neutral. Most beats name no visual kind, so each channel renders them in its own style.

beats.narration: This is the opening beat. It names no visual kind at all, so whichever channel renders it decides what appears on screen.
The second beat is the same. One script, written once, with no idea which channel will eventually use it.
A beat may still ask for something specific when it matters. This one wants a chart, and will get a chart on every channel.
This beat asks for a list, because the content genuinely is a list, regardless of the channel's house style.
And the last beat names nothing again, closing in whatever register the channel uses.
